note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a LIB 9(3); A06b LIB 9(3); L05 LIB 2010(5)): ordinary naturalisation after 10 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Libya, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in Libya for 10 years. ... n.a. ... Person acquires citizenship of another country without prior permission
